title: Feature flag descriptor
description: The git source of record for a single feature flag. `sync-flagship.mjs` mirrors this file's `state` into Cloudflare Flagship on every merge to main; the Flagship dashboard must never be edited directly (see docs/adr for the drift-detection rationale).

key.description: Kebab-case flag identifier. Must match the filename: registry/<key>.json.

description.description: What the flag controls, in plain language, for anyone reading the registry.

repo.description: The daiksudme repository that reads this flag (e.g. "blog").

minVersion.description: The first version of `repo` that can interpret this flag. Consumers must treat the flag as off if their own running version is older than this, even if `state` says on (fail closed, see docs/adr).

state.description: Whether the flag is on in each Flagship environment. Turning `production` on is the Product Release; it does not redeploy any consumer.
